# 权限规则与自动审批 / Permission Rules & Auto-Approval

> 设置 / Setting

设定智能体执行工具时的默认安全边界（需要确认、自动审批或完全访问），配置自动审批审查模型与超时兜底策略，并集中维护全局 Allow / Ask / Deny 规则。

Set the default safety posture for agent tool calls (Ask, Auto-approve, or Full access), configure the auto-approval screener model and timeout fallbacks, and manage global Allow / Ask / Deny rules.

## 适用场景 / When to use it

- 想顺畅推进开发又不愿盲目放开全部权限：切到“自动审批”，让快速模型或专用 Jev 决策模型自动放行常规构建与查看命令，遇到删改关键资源或拿不准的操作再交回给你确认。
  - Staying in flow without giving up safety: switch to Auto-approve so your Fast chat model or the dedicated Jev decision model clears routine build/test steps automatically and only prompts you when an action looks risky or ambiguous.
- 团队或个人有明确的红线命令（如禁止访问特定目录或禁止执行发布脚本）：打开“全局规则”配置高优先级 Deny 规则，同时为高频本地测试脚本添加 Allow 规则免打扰。
  - Enforcing personal or team guardrails: add Deny rules in Global Rules for sensitive paths or deploy commands while whitelisting trusted local test scripts with Allow.
- 在隔离容器或临时实验分支里跑无人值守长任务：阅读风险提示后临时切到“完全访问”，任务结束后直接从聊天输入框下方切回“需要确认”或“自动审批”。
  - Running unattended experiments inside a disposable sandbox: confirm the warning to use Full access during the run, then switch right back to Ask or Auto-approve from below the chat input.

## 完整功能清单 / Everything included

- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 在需要确认（默认）、自动审批与完全访问三种默认权限模式间切换
  - Switch the default permission mode between Ask (default), Auto-approve, and Full access
  - 说明：“需要确认”对写入和命令执行保持人工把关；“自动审批”先由模型评估风险；“完全访问”需二次确认高风险提示，跳过常规询问但依然遵守产品底层硬性安全限制。
  - Why & how: Ask keeps a human in the loop for writes and shell commands; Auto-approve screens calls with an AI reviewer first; Full access requires confirming a risk warning and skips routine prompts while keeping hard product safety limits intact.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 为自动审批选择聊天审查模型或专用 Jev 决策模型并加密保存凭据
  - Choose a chat screener model or dedicated Jev decision model for auto-approval with encrypted credentials
  - 说明：聊天模型模式默认优先选用“快速模型”（亦可改为“主模型”或任一已启用模型）；专用决策模型模式默认使用 jev-latest，其 API Key 仅加密保存在当前执行主机。
  - Why & how: Chat-model mode defaults to your Fast slot (or Primary / any enabled model), while Decision-model mode uses jev-latest by default and stores its API key encrypted on the current execution host.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 设置自动审批超时（默认 30 秒）及模型不确定或报错时的兜底动作
  - Configure auto-approval timeout (30s default) and fallback actions on uncertainty or errors
  - 说明：超时支持 1–300 秒调节；当审查模型返回“不确定”或遭遇网络/超时错误时，可分别设为转为向你弹出确认（默认，防止无故中断任务）或直接拒绝执行。
  - Why & how: Set the timeout anywhere from 1 to 300 seconds, and decide independently whether uncertain verdicts or model/network errors fall back to asking you (default) or rejecting the call.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 编辑与排序全局 Allow、Ask、Deny 权限规则
  - Edit and order global Allow, Ask, and Deny permission rules
  - 说明：在弹窗中管理跨项目通用的允许、询问或禁止规则；单个项目或特定智能体的专属规则可按需覆盖全局默认值。
  - Why & how: Maintain cross-workspace Allow, Ask, and Deny baseline rules in a dedicated dialog; project- or agent-specific rules can override global defaults when needed.
- **智能体可定位入口，需交互完成 / Agent opens; interaction required** · 控制是否在聊天输入框下方显示权限模式快捷选择器
  - Choose whether to show the quick permission-mode switcher below the chat input
  - 说明：开启后可在每个会话底部一眼确认当前处于需要确认、自动审批还是完全访问，并随时按当前任务切换。
  - Why & how: Keep the active permission posture visible right below the composer for per-session switching, or hide it if you prefer a minimal input area.

## 怎么用 / How to use it

1. 按 ⌘,（Windows / Linux 按 Ctrl+,）打开设置，进入“模型与智能体 → 权限规则”
   Press ⌘, (Ctrl+, on Windows/Linux) to open Settings, then go to Models & Agents → Permission Rules
2. 在“默认权限模式”中选择“需要确认”、“自动审批”或“完全访问”，并按习惯决定是否在聊天输入框下方保留快捷切换器
   Under Default permission mode, pick Ask for confirmation, Automatic approval, or Full access, and choose whether to show the quick switcher below the chat input
3. 若选择“自动审批”，在下方挑选聊天审查模型（推荐快速模型）或配置专用决策模型（Jev）及加密 API Key，再核对 30 秒超时与异常兜底策略
   If using Automatic approval, select a chat screener model (Fast model recommended) or configure Decision model (Jev) and its encrypted API key, then review the 30s timeout and fallback policies
4. 在“全局规则”行点击“管理规则”，添加并排序跨项目通用的允许、询问或拒绝规则后保存
   Click Manage rules beside Global rules to add, reorder, and save cross-workspace Allow, Ask, or Deny rules

入口 / Entry: 设置 (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → 模型与智能体 → 权限规则 / Settings (⌘, / Ctrl+,) → Models & Agents → Permission Rules (`⌘, / Ctrl+,`)

## 可以直接对智能体说 / Try saying

- “打开权限规则设置，我想开启自动审批”
  - “Open Permission Rules settings so I can set up Auto-approve”
- “带我去配置全局 Allow 和 Deny 权限规则”
  - “Take me to global Allow and Deny permission rules”
- “我想看看 Jev 决策模型在哪里配置”
  - “Where do I configure the Jev decision model for tool approval?”

## 实用贴士 / Good to know

- “自动审批”模式下，只有默认设为“自动审批”时下方的模型类型、超时与回退下拉框才可编辑；若在远程控制或手机端使用，建议将“不确定时”和“出错时”保留为“询问”，这样远端也能收到审批卡片而不会静默失败。
  - The Auto-approve screener, timeout, and fallback controls become editable once the default mode is set to Auto-approve; keeping both fallbacks on Ask ensures mobile or Remote Connect sessions can still approve edge cases interactively.
- 填写专用决策模型（Jev）的 API Key 后，记得点击输入框右侧的保存图标写入主机加密凭据库；清空密钥同理点击删除图标。
  - After typing a dedicated Jev decision-model API key, click the Save icon beside the password box to store it in the host encrypted credential vault.
- 即使开启“完全访问”，OpenBitFun 内置的产品级硬性安全边界依然生效；项目级规则可在具体工作区中覆盖全局规则。
  - Even in Full access mode, hard product safety boundaries remain enforced, and project-scoped rules can still refine global defaults.

智能体会先查找相关功能或设置，确认目标后再替你打开、执行或修改。完整能力目录不会预先塞进对话上下文。

The agent first finds the relevant feature or setting, confirms the target, and then opens, runs, or changes it for you. The full catalog is never embedded in the conversation context.
